# use-calendar

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse calendar set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-calendar/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-calendar/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-calendar/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-calendar
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
- Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
- Set docs overview: https://rustuse.org/sets/
- Crate docs overview: https://rustuse.org/crates/
- Contributing: https://rustuse.org/contributing/

## Workspace Rustdocs

- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-calendar/

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-calendar/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-calendar/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-calendar/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
